hypothesis: A fresh displaced 1h FVG has conditional value only after closed 15m candles resolve whether the zone was defended or inverted. Global direction, 4h trend and market-attention/flow confluence should reduce false touches.

architecture.formation: Standard three-candle 1h FVG. The middle candle must point in the gap direction, have body at least 0.80 ATR14 and volume at least 1.15 times its prior 20-bar median. Gap depth must be 0.05 to 1.25 ATR.
architecture.defense_route: After first overlap, require a closed 15m directional candle beyond the near edge by 0.03 ATR15, then a later closed candle within three bars breaking the reaction extreme.
architecture.inversion_route: IFVG exists only after a 15m close beyond the far edge by 0.03 ATR15. Use the first later retest from the opposite side, require directional rejection, then a later closed candle within three bars breaking its extreme.
architecture.wick_policy: A wick through the far edge without a close does not create IFVG.
architecture.entry_time: Next 5m open after the completed breakout candle; never inside the source candle.
architecture.zone_policy: First interaction only; maximum age 120 hours; strongest signal only when multiple zones resolve on one candle.

confluence.mandatory_global_regime: Long only in S101 UP, short only in S101 DOWN; SIDEWAYS is cash.
confluence.mandatory_4h_trend: Long above and short below closed-bar EMA50 on 4h.
confluence.micro_score: Require at least two of three: OI expands by at least 0.05% over 60 minutes; 15m taker-buy share and Binance taker ratio agree (>0.52 and >1 for long, <0.48 and <1 for short); 15m volume is at least its prior 20-bar median.
confluence.metrics_freshness: OI can score only when the last public metrics observation is at most 15 minutes old.
confluence.interpretation: Open interest is participation/attention, not a directional signal by itself.

exits_and_risk.initial_stop: Beyond touch/retest extreme plus 0.15 ATR15, never tighter than 0.50 ATR15 and never wider than 4.0 ATR15.
exits_and_risk.intrabar_ambiguity: Stop is evaluated before target on the same 5m candle.

data.source: Checksum-verified public Binance USD-M monthly 5m/1d/funding archives and daily 5m metrics archives.
data.gap_policy: Missing 5m prices are prior-close MTM rows only and are excluded from formation, confirmation, entries, stops and targets.

historical_gate.full_stress: At least 30 trades, positive PnL, profit factor above 1.05, max drawdown at most 10%.
historical_gate.validation: Stress PnL positive with at least 8 trades.
historical_gate.breadth: Both routes and both directions must trade; neither direction may have negative stress PnL; at least two symbols must trade.
historical_gate.robustness: Severe PnL positive, at least two of three leave-one-out replays positive, and bootstrap p10 terminal PnL positive.

decision_policy.historical: All periods are research-contaminated. The replay may reject the strategy but cannot validate live profitability.
decision_policy.paper_forward: Only a complete gate pass may start a new prospective paper-forward clock after the report is frozen.

disclosures: Parameters were fixed before downloading or inspecting S103 5m kline history.
The S101 global regime was selected using earlier research and is not independent.
No profit is guaranteed; all reported PnL is simulated after stated costs.
